# JSTOR

> JSTOR is a comprehensive digital library providing access to millions of academic journals, books, primary sources, and images for research and teaching.

JSTOR serves researchers, students, and librarians worldwide by offering peer-reviewed scholarly content, research tools, and digital humanities resources. The platform includes curated collections from partners like Artstor and ITHAKA, supporting interdisciplinary research across humanities, social sciences, and sciences.

## Key Topics

- JSTOR digital library
- Academic journals and books

## Core Platform

- [JSTOR Home](https://logon.jstor.org/): JSTOR digital library homepage for accessing millions of academic journals, books, and primary sources
- [JSTOR Labs](https://labstest.jstor.org/): Innovation hub for research tools and digital humanities projects

## Guides and Resources

- [JSTOR LibGuides Home](https://guides.jstor.org/home): How-to guides and teaching resources for researchers and educators
- [JSTOR Access Guide for Libraries](https://guides.jstor.org/for-libraries/remote): Success guide for libraries on managing access and digital resources
